canonical_source.checkpoint_policy: Read this checkpoint commit from Git history; no circular self-reference.

plugin.published_readback: Metadata and all 11 changed text files inspected; not a full published-archive checksum comparison.

implemented: Stream UTF-8 response limits while reading; reject oversized payloads before full buffering.
Cancel stalled, rejected non-JSON and late-response bodies.
Reject same-revision changes to displayed location, equipment, spell resources, party and journal.
Reject duplicate/empty party IDs without treating JSON key order as a change.
Preserve uncertain-action duplicate guards; record ten ordered full-release acceptance gates.
remaining: Existing native Site source, complete typecheck/build and reviewed publication.
Production native authentication, durable atomic transactions, source-backed resolver and correlated receipt/save integration.
Native action-save-reload and multiple-device acceptance journeys.
Required canon/rules and scene/media completeness audit.
Desktop/390px, physical iPhone and actual speaker/headphone listening.
Backup/restore, authorized binary-media parity and distribution readiness.
synchronization: Inspect actual main and current plugin release before work; test coherent changes, preserve source pins, publish guarded overlays, inspect readback, merge expected tested heads and checkpoint exact references. No continuous background sync is claimed.

rollback.procedure: Restore intended source using reviewed new commits and a guarded plugin update; never reset the real campaign.
